meta.name: Tailor resumes to RemoteOK jobs with OpenAI and Google Workspace

name: AI Job Application & Resume Tailoring Agent

parameters.content:
## 🤖 AI Job Application & Resume Tailoring Agent

### How it works
Every 6 hours, the workflow fetches the latest remote jobs from RemoteOK's API and downloads your master resume from Google Drive — both in parallel. The jobs are filtered and normalised, then merged with the extracted resume text. A GPT-4o-mini agent scores each job against your resume (0–10 match score). Jobs scoring 7 or above are passed to a second GPT agent that rewrites the resume tailored specifically to that job — adjusting the summary, skills emphasis, and experience wording. The tailored resume is converted to a file, uploaded to your Google Drive folder, and the application is logged to a Google Sheets tracking sheet with the company, position, URL, match score, and Drive link.

### Setup steps
1. Connect **Google Drive OAuth2** to the three Drive nodes. Replace `REPLACE_WITH_MASTER_RESUME_FILE_ID` in the Download Master Resume node.
2. Connect **OpenAI API** to both OpenAI Chat Model nodes.
3. Connect **Google Sheets OAuth2** to the Log node. Replace `YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID` with your tracking sheet ID.
4. Replace `REPLACE_WITH_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID` in Upload Tailored Resume with your target folder.
5. Adjust the match score threshold in `Match Score >= 7?` to your preference.
6. Activate the schedule trigger.

## ⏰ Job Feed & Resume Fetch
Two parallel paths fire every 6 hours: one fetches the latest remote jobs from RemoteOK's API and filters/normalises the results; the other downloads your master resume PDF from Google Drive and extracts the text. Both merge before AI processing begins.

## 🎯 AI Job Match Scoring
Builds a prompt combining the job description and your resume text, then passes it to GPT-4o-mini. The agent returns a match score (0–10) with reasoning. Scores below 7 are routed to `Skip - Low Match` and discarded. Only strong matches proceed to tailoring.

nodes.name: Section – AI Resume Tailoring & File Generation

parameters.content:
## ✍️ AI Resume Tailoring & File Generation
For each high-match job: builds a tailoring prompt with the job description + master resume text, then a second GPT agent rewrites the resume to match the role. The tailored output is parsed, converted to a file, and uploaded to your Google Drive folder.

## 📋 Application Tracking Log
Appends a row to Google Sheets for every tailored application: company, position, job URL, match score, AI reasoning, tailored resume Drive link, and timestamp. Gives you a running log of every application the agent has prepared.

## 🔑 Credentials Required
- **Google Drive OAuth2** — master resume download + tailored resume upload
- **OpenAI API** — match scoring agent + resume tailoring agent
- **Google Sheets OAuth2** — application tracking log

Replace all `REPLACE_WITH_*` placeholders before activating.
